newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Australand IPO placement tranche fully subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Australand IPO placement tranche fully subscribed.

text.p: Australian Property Development group Australand Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday placement shares in its initial public offer (IPO) for Singapore had been fully taken up.
It said in a statement a total of 28.9 million vendor shares were offered in Singapore, comprising a public tranche of 5.8 million shares and a placement tranche of 23.1 million shares.
Earlier this month, share offers in Singapore and Australia were announced for dual listing on the Stock Exchange of Singapore (SES) and the Australian Stock Exchange (ASX).
Australand is a subsidiary of Singapore property and hotel company DBS Land Ltd.
The Australian share offer of 48 million new shares opened on May 19 and will close on June 5.
Australand said institutional interest in Australia had also been positive. "Demand has substantially exceeded the portion of the offer allocated to them," the statement said.
All the shares have a par value of Australian $0.50 each and are priced at A$1.20 each.
The Singapore offer was managed and underwritten by DBS Bank and will close on June 12, and the Australian offer by SBC Warburg Australia Ltd.
Trading on the stock exchanges of both countries are due to begin on June 16.
